name: connect.com.au
summary: ABS-cited Australia's first commercial internet provider (1992); absorbed InterConnect by 1996; acquired by AAPT 3 Feb 1999.

events.details: Founded 1992 in South Melbourne; one of the first companies to bring the Internet to Australia (its own 'About Connect' page states 'Founded in 1992').
Acquired by AAPT (3 Feb 1999); by 2000 the 'About Connect' page described Connect as a wholly owned subsidiary of AAPT Limited.
